<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **206** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **143** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 727091c821d7dcaedb4eea547b77933838b471ed` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `a66b47182e19561578a63d0c3c4c7955dabca68d`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts + packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts, packages/spec/src/inline-grid-column-carriers.test.ts, packages/spec/liveness/page.json, packages/spec/json-schema.manifest/ui.json, packages/spec/package.json, and in objectui at the pin `5e15928b4` (also objectui `26323c4fc`): packages/plugin-form/src/LineItemsPanel.tsx, packages/plugin-form/src/deriveMasterDetail.ts, packages/fields/src/widgets/GridField.tsx. Remainder of the diff (the lane seat's ACCEPT at `TIER_DEFAULT`): `.changeset/24140-line-items-columns-hydrate.md`, `content/docs/references/ui/component.mdx` — both read here too, for ② and ①-2.

Inputs: card #24140 (body, comments 6229394877 / 6234986989 / 6236296173), PR #24188 (body, file list, net diff against `main`, merge base `cb8756b00`), the head's check-runs. Code read with `git show` at `a66b47182` and in the objectui checkout; nothing built, run or re-run.

### ① Derived judgments

1. **Accept set: unchanged — right.** The only code line the diff touches is the `.describe()` string on `columns: z.array(InlineGridColumnSchema).min(1)`; the Zod chain is byte-identical, no key is added or removed, no refinement moves. Consistent with the dev's H4 reading (JSON Schema structurally identical with descriptions stripped; `authorable-surface/` byte-identical) and with `Type Check · source gates` green, which carries `check:authorable-surface` and `check:docs`. `Clause-②: no` is the right declaration.
2. **Public surface: description text only — right.** The `columns` description in the shipped JSON Schema (`ui/RecordLineItemsProps.json`, the `objectstack.json` `$defs` copy) and one regenerated row in `content/docs/references/ui/component.mdx` (`check:docs`, green). `json-schema.manifest/ui.json` records schema names only, so it rightly does not move. `Spec property liveness` green; no ledger row quotes the old text (`page.json:57` entries [15], [16], [109] are read points for `record:line_items`; `view.json` and `field.json` carry no `line_items` row).
3. **The new describe, claim by claim against the cited code — right.**
   - "As on the master-detail carriers, identity-only entries ({ name }) hydrate everything else from the child object's fields": the carriers' sentence verbatim (`field.zod.ts:1654` `inlineColumns`; `component.zod.ts:7150` `object-master-detail-form` detail `columns`). objectui `hydrateColumns` (`deriveMasterDetail.ts:305` at the pin) hydrates a column with no `type`: fills `type`, `label` (an authored one is kept), `required`, select `options`, lookup `reference`/`displayField`, file props, `readonlyWhen`/`requiredWhen`, computed `expr`. "`label`, `type` and `options` included" is a true subset.
   - "Declaring `type` opts a column out of hydration": `if (col.type) return col` — right, and it is `InlineGridColumnSchema.type`'s own rule (`field.zod.ts:972`).
   - "headed by the child field's label and translates with it": the hydrated label is the child schema's field label, the same path the master-detail headings take. The page overlay's copy keys (`PAGE_COMPONENT_COPY_KEYS`, `i18n-resolver.ts:2119`: title, description, label, placeholder, emptyText on a component's own `properties`) never reach `properties.columns[i].label`, so the card's premise holds and hydration is the only translation path that adds no key — the dispatch's "no new key" is honoured.
   - "Required, with at least one column: nothing derives them": `.min(1)` unchanged; `LineItemsPanel` derives nothing. Dropping "drawn exactly as declared" was necessary: it contradicted hydration.
4. **The TSDoc (shipped as `src/**/*.zod.ts`) — right.**
   - Transition window ("Until the `.objectui-sha` pin carries it … an identity-only column draws as a text cell headed by its name"): true at the pin `5e15928b4` (unchanged by this PR) and still at objectui `26323c4fc`: `LineItemsPanel.tsx:748` is `applyColumnPermissions(schema.columns, …)`, zero `hydrat` hits in the file; `GridField.tsx:1005` heads a column with `c.label || c.name` and hydrates nothing itself.
   - "`collectHydratedInlineColumnErrors` walks the three master-detail carriers and not this block": `stack.zod.ts:3613` (`inlineColumns`), `:3628` (`subforms[].columns`), `:3639`–`:3645` (`object-master-detail-form` `details[].columns`); no `record:line_items` arm. "today `currency`, which refuses `scale`": `HYDRATED_INLINE_COLUMN_TYPE` has the one `currency` row.
   - Holding the gate extension out of this PR is right and correctly sequenced, not only out of scope: that gate judges a column "against the type they will render as" (its own docblock), and at the pinned console a line-items identity-only column renders as text, so judging it as the child field's type before objectui#12854 and the pin bump would refuse what today renders. It is a `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)` change of its own; the gap is disclosed in the shipped TSDoc rather than advertised closed (Prime Directive #10).
5. **`field.zod.ts` untouched — right.** `InlineGridColumnSchema`'s docblock (`:946`–`:952`) and the `label`/`type` describes (`:971`–`:972`) state the rule for the column, not per carrier; after this PR they are true on every carrier.
6. **`Fixes #24140` — right.** Triage's grade (6229394877) defines this card as the spec half, with the renderer half on its own card (objectstack-ai/objectui#12854, `Blocked-by:` this card); the dispatch claim (6234986989) names the dev's branch; `The card this PR closes must claim this branch` and `Part-of PR must not also close its card` are green.
7. **Face and tier — right.** Three paths, none governed; `reviewFace` hits = `packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts` (schema face, `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`); head repo = base repo; `Governed Surface Queue Guard` green.

### ② Semver level

`.changeset/24140-line-items-columns-hydrate.md`: `'@objectstack/spec': patch`, `Clause-②: no` at a line start with no arm, body states before, after and the transition window; the PR body's `Clause-②: no` matches. `@objectstack/spec` is published (`private` unset; `files` ships `dist`, `json-schema`, `src/**/*.zod.ts`) and the changed text ships in all three, so `patch` — not `skip-changeset` — is right (AGENTS.md Post-Task Checklist 3). `no` with `patch` is the well-formed pair: nothing widens or narrows the accept set (①-1). No model identifier anywhere in the diff. `Check Changeset` green. **Clause-②: no — agreed.**

### ③ Boundary flags

`open_questions`: none declared. Dev flags (acceptance notes 1–5, `deviations` 0–3, `out_of_scope_findings` 0–4), each answered or escalated:

- **F1 — the `defineStack` gate does not reach this block** (note 1, finding [0], deviation [3]). Answered: right to hold off, see ①-4. Escalated to the dispatching seat: file the card in objectstack at ACCEPT (`Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/objectui#12854`, back-link #24140), naming two sentences this PR leaves behind for that card's PR to rewrite: (i) `stack.zod.ts` `collectHydratedInlineColumnErrors` docblock, "All three carriers of the column are walked" — shipped bytes on a non-exported function; once this lands there are four hydrating carriers and three walked, so "All" undercounts. The contract's truth is carried by the new TSDoc in `component.zod.ts`, so this is a flag, not a FAIL; a text-only rider here would equally do, and keeps `Clause-②: no`. (ii) `inline-grid-column-carriers.test.ts:615`–`:620` ("pinned on purpose: … no hydration from the child object's field") and the CONTROL title at `:740` — not shipped; the CONTROL assertion itself stays true and is the pin on the gate's reach.
- **F2 — the transition window** (note 2, finding [1]). Answered: the shipped TSDoc and the changeset both state it; the describe (JSON Schema and docs) does not, which is acceptable under triage's spec-half-first route and Prime Directive #12 (the renderer half is filed with `Blocked-by:`), and the changeset's last sentence ("keep explicit labels on columns you need headed today") is the author-facing mitigation. Escalated to the pin bump that carries objectui#12854: delete the TSDoc sentence beginning "Until the `.objectui-sha` pin carries it".
- **F3 — showcase invoice comments** (note 3, finding [2]). Answered: held off per the dispatch's hold-offs; non-shipping example comments; #23985's PR owns them.
- **F4 — `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/pages.md:112`–`:113`** (note 4, finding [3]). Answered: Tier H, untouched; identity-only columns match the new contract; no change owed.
- **F5 — `main` moved** (note 5, deviation [2]). Answered: not merged, per the dispatch; mergeable per GitHub; `main` has moved again since (`2bcaefba9` at this read) with no overlap on these hunks; the queue rebuilds the merge.
- **F6 — bare `--` dropped `--maxWorkers`** (deviation [0]). Answered: a local-run detail; CI's `Test Core` is the gate verdict.
- **F7 — closure builds and the shallow fixture fetch** (deviation [1]). Answered: no bearing on the contract.
- **F8 — H5 rest** (finding [4]). Answered: confirmed on the ledger at head (①-2).

The gate verdicts are theirs; this verdict is on the contract. Landing still waits for every check green (contract-review.md, second pre-landing check).
